items.title: 27 arrests and 248 potential victims identified in action week against labour exploitation
items.summary: Europol, the European Labour Authority (ELA), and 34 participating countries today announced the results of an action week targeting human trafficking for labour exploitation. The operation, part of an EMPACT action led by Sweden, brought together police, border guards, labour and social security inspectorates, and tax authorities to crack down on exploitative practices in high-risk sectors such as agriculture, construction, cosmetic services, massage parlours, and hospitality.

items.title: 5th EMPACT Hackathon leads to the detection of 51 potential victims
